MEMO TO THE BOARD OF [AUTHORITY]
Re: Proposed taxable revenue bond and PILOT for [COMPANY]'s [PROJECT] in [COUNTY]

Counsel's caution first: none of the figures below is a round number, and I do not trust any that look like one. The $12,000,000 taxable bond (20 years, 4.50%, 240 level monthly payments) carries a payment of about $75,917.90 a month, or $911,014.80 a year, and total interest of roughly $6,220,296. Against projected net operating income of $1,500,000, coverage is 1.6465x, which is adequate but rests entirely on a projection. Loan-to-value on $27,000,000 of investment is 0.4444.

The PILOT applies to the $18,000,000 building only; equipment is excluded, so the abatement is smaller than the headline investment suggests. Full tax is $205,200 a year (40% assessment, 28.5 mills). Years 1-5 are fully abated, then the abatement steps down ten points a year. The company pays $41,040 in year 7. Over 15 years, $1,949,400 is abated and $1,128,600 is paid. Discounted at 5.0%, the abatement is worth about $1,496,855 today.

On 150 jobs and a $7,800,000 payroll, the abatement is $12,996 per job over 15 years. Ambiguity: the year-15 full-tax assumption and end-of-year discounting are as specified; the board should confirm both.
